title: Adze workspace/user config (.adze/config.jsonc)
description: JSONC (// and /* */ comments allowed). Credentials never live here — they belong in .adze/providers.json or the environment. Precedence: CLI flags > environment > workspace .adze/config.jsonc > ~/.adze/config.jsonc > defaults. See docs/guides/configuration.md.

$schema.description: Schema reference for editors. Ignored by the loader.

engines.description: Engine version this file was written for. Stamped by `chat /init`; a mismatch warns.

engine.description: Model selection. Env overrides: ADZE_MODEL, ADZE_EFFORT, ADZE_TEMPERATURE, ADZE_MAX_TOKENS, ADZE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.

effort.description: Reasoning effort (OpenAI-style; Anthropic models do not accept it).

maxTokens.description: Budget ceiling: total tokens for the turn. Omitted when unbounded.

maxOutputTokens.description: Per-request cap forwarded to the provider.

sandbox.description: What the agent may do. Env overrides: ADZE_SANDBOX_BROKER, ADZE_SANDBOX_MODE, ADZE_WRITABLE_ROOTS, ADZE_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Semantics per ADR-0007; invalid mode narrows to read-only.

broker.description: Mechanism preference. auto (default) selects per platform; an explicit value is validated, reported by doctor, and warns when the host selects otherwise.

writableRoots.description: Absolute paths writable under workspace-write. The workspace root is always included by the CLI; these widen it. Relative entries are ignored with a warning.

allowedNetworkHosts.description: Hosts reachable when the mode would otherwise deny network. Exact host match.

approvals.description: When the user is asked. Env overrides: ADZE_APPROVAL_POLICY (ADZE_APPROVAL also read). never refuses rather than escalating. Invalid policy narrows to never.

commandRules.description: Per-command overrides, matched as a prefix of the requested command (ADR-0013). Env: ADZE_ALLOW, ADZE_FORBID, ADZE_PROMPT (comma-separated). A lower layer never weakens a higher layer's forbid into an allow.

forbid.description: Refused outright, never offered for approval. Beats every mode including full-access.

prompt.description: Always ask. Protocol-level; the CLI flags do not emit it.

plugins.description: Procedural plugin runtimes need an explicit opt-in: a JS/native module runs unsandboxed with the engine's full privileges. Env: ADZE_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED_JS, ADZE_ALLOW_NATIVE, ADZE_ON_HOOK_FAILURE.

allowUnsandboxedJs.description: Required to load runtime js hooks/providers. Default false.

allowNative.description: Required to load runtime native modules. Default false, never enabled silently.

onHookFailure.description: What a failing policy hook does. refuse (default) fails closed.

dirs.description: Extra directories to load plugins from.

enable.description: Plugin ids to enable. Empty means no filter.

disable.description: Plugin ids to disable. Wins over enable on overlap.

config.description: Per-plugin opaque settings, keyed by plugin id.

todo.description: Whether the todo planning tool is available. Default true.

gallery.description: Extension gallery. Only Open VSX: a Microsoft Marketplace URL is rejected per ADR-0009. Env: ADZE_OPENVSX_URL.

openVsxUrl.description: Open VSX registry URL, e.g. https://open-vsx.org. Never the Microsoft Marketplace.

defaultModel.description: Deprecated alias for engine.model. Warns when used with a value.
